title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 101-104 (Daridryadhvamsini, Devi (second time), Sarvopadravavarini, Navadurga)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 101 to 104: Daridryadhvamsini, Devi (second time), Sarvopadravavarini, Navadurga, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 101 to 104 with meaning
caption: Names 101 to 104 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 101 to 104**: **Daridryadhvamsini, Devi (second time), Sarvopadravavarini, Navadurga**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Daridryadhvamsini, Devi (second time), Sarvopadravavarini, Navadurga.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Daridryadhvamsini** means **Crusher of poverty**. Crusher of poverty; the stotra repeats the idea to stress hope.
**Devi (second time)** means **The Goddess**. The Goddess is called Devi with deep reverence.
**Sarvopadravavarini** means **Warder-off of all troubles**. Warder-off of all troubles, accidents and calamities.
**Navadurga** means **The nine Durgas**. In Devi tradition Lakshmi is not separate from Durga; the Devi is one.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
